faqs.question: Does it run without mains power?
faqs.answer: Yes. An internal high-capacity battery powers off-grid and in-field operation, with a charge indicator at 100, 75, 50, and 25 percent.

sections.title: What the TE-MCT detector actually buys you
body: The detector is what separates a field spectrometer that merely survives outdoors from one that performs there.
A standard DTGS detector works, but it's slower and less sensitive than it needs to be once external conditions start interfering, which is exactly what a warehouse floor or a construction site does.

The TE-MCT detector in the MOBILE-IR II is cooled thermoelectrically rather than with liquid nitrogen, and Bruker states it halves measurement time and doubles signal-to-noise ratio against a standard DTGS detector, with the added benefit of greater spectral stability against those external influences.
